reference: Gyihova Ɛboa Me Yemaa Menyia Subane Kpalɛ
hypothesis: Jehovah bu amen, ima minya suba nu kpale.

reference: yɛmaa ninyɛne mɔɔ hyia la kɔ zo tɛnla yɛ adwenle nu a?
hypothesis: Ameniiɛ ne a nwunyɛ ya ajunra, dizo etia okee, yemeniɛ ne mɔ shiara kwazutena ya ajunlunaa.

reference: DEƐMƆTI ƆBAHOLA YEAYƐ SE KƐ Ɛ NYE BALIE DAHUU LA
hypothesis: Gye moti ọbahwɛ ya ye seke enyi be ri edahuwula.

reference: Deɛmɔti yɛkola yɛka kɛ kɛmɔ Gyisɛse se anwunvɔne na ɔlɛ ahunluyelɛyelalɛ la ati ɔle Ɛsɔfo Kpanyinli mɔɔ tɛla biala nee kɛzi ɔboa yɛ wɔ ndenle ngakyile zo ɛnɛ la.
hypothesis: Dịka mụ na ya kparịrị nkea, kama ọji sese mụ nwa nị nọlụ ya ịrịarịrị tị ọrịa sọfụ kpeịrị nụ mwatere bịara. Nịkeị sọ gbuwaị wụ ọndịrị ịngẹchịrị zụ enera.

reference: Deɛmɔti Ɛnee Ɔzɔho Kɛ Ɔnrɛyɛ Boɛ La
hypothesis: Demoti ɛne ozon ka ɔnla ya gbolah.

reference: Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na ‘yɛahɔ zo yɛabɔ yɛ ɛbɛla kɛ wienyi nu mralɛ’ ɛ?
hypothesis: Kọkọ ene ahọzị ya agba ya bọla ke ewu enu maley.

reference: Duzu A Yɛze Wɔ Kɛzi Gyihova Babua Ndɛne Kenle Bie La Anwo A?
hypothesis: Duzu ayileka kɛɛ Jehovah Bagua ne kilembialɛ anwo.

reference: Kɔ Zo Sukoa Debie Fi Baebolo Nu Mɔlebɛbo Ngilehilelɛ Ne Anu?
hypothesis: Kwazuzu kwanabi efi Bible n'umolaba bo nglehyirele ne enu.

reference: SAA WƆ ADWENLE NU YƐ WƆ KESEE KƐ SAA Ɛ NWO TƐKYIA GYIHOVA A
hypothesis: Saa adwene no yɛ kese kɛse sa ɛwoteɛ Jehovah.

reference: Nyia “Azɛlɛ Ye Kɔsɔɔti Ndɛnebuavolɛ Ne” Mɔɔ Se Anwunvɔne La Anu Anwodozo!
hypothesis: Nya azahra ikoso tinane gbu avula ne mose envunla enua nwudozo.

reference: Kɛzi Gyihova bahola aboa wɔ yeamaa yeawie wɔ boɛ ɛ?
hypothesis: Kɛví Gyihova bahola abua wo yamye yɛwiawɔ bua ɛ?

reference: GYIHOVA ƐLƐBOA YE MENLI NE ƐNƐ
hypothesis: Jehovah ele bueh imeli ne ene.

reference: Fa Yɛ Wɔ Bodane Kɛ Ɛbamaa Bɛazɔne Wɔ
hypothesis: Fahyɛw bɔdane kɛba maba zɔnu.

reference: Kɛzi yɛkola yɛnwu kɛ bɛtɛkakyile Baebolo ne anu edwɛkɛ ne ɛ?
hypothesis: Kɛzi yɛkrayɛn kɛɛ bɛtɛka kyire Baebolo nu ɛjɔɛkɛ ne?

reference: YƐHYIA DIEDI AMAA BƐABU YƐ KƐ YƐLE TENLENEMA
hypothesis: Yɛsi adieedi, ama bagua yɛkɛ yɛretene na ma.

reference: Duzu a agyalɛma bahola ayɛ amaa bɛanyia mekɛ bɛamaa bɛ nwo a?
hypothesis: Duzu a gyale mgbahura aye, ama be nya me ke ba ama be nwu a?

reference: Amaa wɔamia anwodozo mɔɔ ɛlɛ kɛ Gyihova a le Selɛ ne mɔɔ ɛhyia nwo la anu la, duzu ati a ɛnva buluku ɛhye ɛnyɛ ɛ ti anwo debiezukoalɛ anzɛɛ ɛnyɛ ngyehyɛleɛ ɛngenga ye bieko a?
hypothesis: Amanwụ mị aṅụ dozo, mụ aṅụrụkwa mmanya na-egbu egbu, mụ echighịkwa nụla. Dozuo otu a, enweghịkwa onye ga-enyetị aụ ndị bi ebe ahụ nsogbu, ma ọ bụ enye ndị isi ala nsogbu.

reference: Mɔɔ Baebolo Ne Maa Yɛnwu Ye Wɔ Ye Kɛlɛvolɛ Ne Anwo La
hypothesis: Mọ Baibolo ne mɛ yɛnwu iwɔ ikale vule ne anwula.

reference: DEBIE MƆƆ ƐBAHOLA WƆAZUKOA LA
hypothesis: Dibiɛmɔ ebahwɛwɛ zukara.
